Definition
[$\alpha $-Hölder distance]

Source: petersen:page-0438, petersen:page-0439 ↗ def:pet-ch11-holder-pseudonorm For metric spaces $X,Y$, define their $\alpha $-Hölder distance $d_\alpha (X,Y)$ as the infimum, over homeomorphisms $F:X o Y$, of \[ \log \max \Big\{ \sup _{x_1 e x_2} rac{|F(x_1)F(x_2)|}{|x_1x_2|^\alpha }, \sup _{y_1 e y_2} rac{|F^{-1}(y_1)F^{-1}(y_2)|}{|y_1y_2|^\alpha }\Big\} . \]
